verdict.rationale: Clerk documents its own Enterprise SSO over SAML and OIDC with IdPs like Azure AD, Okta and Google Workspace, with user data synchronized into Clerk. It also documents multi-tenant Organizations. However, no evidence ties an SSO connection to an individual customer organization, and nothing covers domain verification or just-in-time provisioning into the org. missing for 10: per-organization SSO connection assignment, verified-domain routing/enforcement, just-in-time provisioning of users into organizations, independent or hands-on corroboration.
